description: Analyze a Minecraft Java world: how many chunks exist, how much disk they use, how much of the world players never visited, and how much space pruning would free at each threshold. Safe while the server runs.
name: get_world_activity

estimates.description: Savings per prune threshold, spawn and player positions already protected.

free_mb.description: Disk it would free, in MB.

threshold.description: Prune threshold label, e.g. "never visited" or "under 5 min".

never_visited_chunks.description: Chunks no player has ever lingered in.

title: Get World Activity
